name: Moloni ON
description:
Moloni ON is AT-certified invoicing and commercial management software for Portuguese businesses. This connector lets Claude work directly with your Moloni ON account:

• Documents — create invoices, invoice-receipts, simplified invoices, credit notes, debit notes, estimates, pro-forma invoices, delivery notes and receipts. Documents are always created as drafts and only issued when you decide: close them in the Moloni app (a deep link is returned with every draft) or ask Claude to close them — closing a document or emailing an invoice always requires your explicit confirmation. You can also generate public, shareable PDF download links for any document.

• Customers & products — search, inspect and create customers and products, with a preview-and-confirm step before anything is written.

• Sales insight — aggregated sales analysis by product or date, outstanding/unpaid documents per customer or as a flat list, and current stock levels.

• Company data — taxes, payment methods, product categories and document sets are resolved automatically from your company's settings; multi-company accounts can switch the active company at any time.

Requires a Moloni ON subscription with the "API Clients" module enabled. Claude accesses your data via OAuth on your behalf — you authenticate directly with Moloni ON and no credentials are ever shared with the connector.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Moloni ON to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Moloni ON to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.molonion.pt/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Moloni ON MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moloni ON lists 20 MCP tools, including company_list, company_select, customer_create, customer_get, customer_list, document_close, document_create, document_download, document_get, document_list, document_send_email, and payment_method_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Moloni ON?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Moloni ON in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Moloni ON MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moloni ON requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Moloni ON is developed by Moloni. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
